title: ghe_transcribe: audio transcription with speaker diarization using Faster Whisper and Pyannote
description: ghe_transcribe is a Python tool to transcribe audio files with speaker diarization. It uses Faster Whisper for transcription and Pyannote for speaker diarization, writes TXT and SRT output, and offers both a Jupyter interface and a command line tool. It is developed by the Global Health Engineering group at ETH Zurich.
